sevenSongExpansion.note: Uses the same 19-note MP3 bank. New music is compact note JSON, rendered locally; no external playback service.

replacement.note: Only compact notation changes. The same 19-note sample bank is decoded once; no per-song audio downloads.

sixSongRemoval.measurement: Runtime bytes here count the 19 shared sample files and six compact note JSON files; unchanged player code and metadata are excluded.
